name: Zimbabwe

latest_census.notes: 2022 Population and Housing Census (20-30 April 2022; Volume 1 population figures released 2022, thematic volumes 2023-2024). The 2012 census asked religion and published it by province in the National Report (Apostolic sects the largest group), and I believe the 2022 questionnaire kept the religion item, but I cannot confirm it from memory. Ethnicity: Zimbabwean censuses ask citizenship rather than tribe/ethnic group as far as I recall, but not confidently enough to declare 'not asked' - null. Language: not recalled - null.

subnational_sources.title: 2022 Population and Housing Census - thematic report / volume covering religion, by province (and possibly district)
subnational_sources.evidence: Contingent on the 2022 questionnaire having retained religion; the report series is hosted on zimstat.co.zw.

subnational_sources.title: Zimbabwe Population Census 2012 - National Report (ZIMSTAT, 2013): population by religion and province
subnational_sources.evidence: The 2012 National Report's religion chapter is the source of the widely quoted 'Apostolic sect / Pentecostal / Protestant / Roman Catholic / traditional / none' split.

subnational_sources.title: Zimbabwe Population Census 2012 - Provincial Reports (one per province), with district tables
subnational_sources.matches_boundary_level: unclear: the boundary file draws 91 admin2 shapes, more than Zimbabwe's ~60 rural/urban districts - the shapes may be a different districting (e.g. including urban councils); expect a partial join
subnational_sources.confidence: medium (recalled that the reports exist; low that religion is tabulated by district in them)
subnational_sources.evidence: ZIMSTAT issued ten provincial reports for 2012 with district-level demographic tables.

subnational_sources.title: IPUMS-International - Zimbabwe 1992, 2002, 2012 census samples
subnational_sources.evidence: IPUMS holds Zimbabwe's 2012 census with a religion variable (I believe); registration required.

subnational_sources.title: ZIMSTAT NADA microdata catalogue (census 2012 / 2022)
subnational_sources.evidence: Most African NSOs run a NADA; the repo's probe_nada.py can test zimstat.co.zw for one.

tier_reason: A census count of religion exists by province (2012 National Report, PDF; 10 provinces = admin1) and probably in the 2022 thematic reports; nothing machine-readable is known to me, and the 91 admin2 shapes do not obviously correspond to Zimbabwe's ~60 districts. Ethnicity and language may not be census items at all.
recommended_action: Crawl zimstat.co.zw for the 2022 census report series; if a religion-by-province table exists, read it with probe_pdf.py and replace the Afrobarometer R9 survey now on the 10 provinces (owner review). Otherwise use the 2012 National Report. Before touching admin2, establish what the 91 shapes are - if they are not the census districts, no census table will join. Do not declare ethnicity or language not_collected from this finding; check the 2022 questionnaire first.
not_found: confirmation that the 2022 questionnaire asked religion; whether it asked ethnicity or language
any XLSX/CSV release of census religion tables
what geography the 91 admin2 shapes represent (Zimbabwe has ~60 districts)
summary: ZIMSTAT (zimstat.co.zw) counted religion in the 2012 census and published it by the 10 provinces (= admin1) in the National Report PDF, and the 2022 census very likely retained the item with thematic volumes now out; either would replace the Afrobarometer survey estimates currently on admin1. Ethnicity and language may not be census items, but I cannot say so confidently. The 91 admin2 shapes exceed Zimbabwe's ~60 districts, so district joins need the shapes identified first. Tier B.
